articles.title: Anduril and Qualcomm launch BlueChip to onshore computer manufacturing
articles.description: Investing.com -- Defense technology startup Anduril Industries has partnered with Qualcomm Incorporated (NASDAQ:QCOM) to launch BlueChip, a new hardware initiative aimed at designing and manufacturing personal computers entirely within the United States. Unveiled on Tuesday, the collaboration focuses on producing secure, domestic laptops tailored for defense, public safety, and government agencies seeking to mitigate overseas supply chain vulnerabilities.

articles.title: Qualcomm Just Dropped 13% in a Month. Is It Time to Sell, or Load Up?
articles.description: Key TakeawaysQualcomm (QCOM:NASDAQ) stock dropped 13% in the month through October 22, with a September 28 semiconductor selloff accounting for more than half the decline.
